Bitcoin is down 52% from its record. Does a 52% rise get it back? No.

Fortune put Bitcoin at $60,458.70 at 7:45 a.m. ET on Nov 24, 2026, about 52% below its record of $126,198.07 on Oct 6, 2025. A 52% rise from $60,459 only reaches about $92,000. Getting back to the record would take a rise of about 109%, more than double. That's not a prediction, just how percentages work: a fall shrinks the base, so the climb back has to be bigger. Crypto products are unregulated and can be highly risky.

Did you know losses and gains aren't the same size?
